title: 根据麦当劳 2026 NEXT 战略，把速度、服务和顾客价值说到一起
topic: 依据麦当劳 2026 年 NEXT 战略信息，说明顾客期待、共同目标和本地行动空间

source.title: Our Next Era of Growth & Productivity: Introducing McDonald’s > NEXT
source.readingTitle: When speed rises, hospitality matters more
source.section: 致 McDonald’s System 的业务更新
source.type: 致 McDonald’s System 的业务更新
source.context: 把速度、服务和顾客价值说到一起
paragraphs: Restaurant customers can compare menus, prices and service with a few taps. As ordering becomes more digital, visits may move faster, but guests also have fewer chances to speak with the crew. A quick order still needs to feel welcoming.

McDonald’s is bringing these demands under one goal: become the first choice for more customers, more often. That means keeping food, hospitality, convenience and value together. The company also wants each restaurant to operate more effectively, so growth can support a stronger business.

The goal is shared across the system, but the actions can differ by market. One team may test a clearer value offer; another may simplify a popular menu or improve handoffs between digital orders and crew. Local teams know which changes fit their customers and their restaurants.
translations: 顾客可以轻点几下，就比较不同餐厅的菜单、价格和服务。随着点餐越来越数字化，到店流程可能更快，但顾客与员工交流的机会也更少。点单再快，也仍要让人感到受到欢迎。
麦当劳把这些需求归到一个目标下：让更多顾客更常选择麦当劳。这意味着要兼顾食品、待客体验、便利和价格。公司也希望每家门店运营得更有效，让增长带动更稳健的业务。
各市场共享同一个目标，但可以采取不同做法。一支团队可能测试更清晰的优惠方案；另一支团队可能精简热门菜单，或改善数字订单与员工之间的交接。当地团队更了解哪些调整适合顾客和门店。
fullTextParagraphs: Restaurant customers can compare menus, prices and service with a few taps. As ordering becomes more digital, visits may move faster, but guests also have fewer chances to speak with the crew. A quick order still needs to feel welcoming.

The market is shifting on both sides of the counter. Established competitors are updating menus, while specialists are setting new expectations for taste and quality. At the same time, customers want prices they can plan around. Winning a visit once does not guarantee the next one.

McDonald’s is bringing these demands under one goal: become the first choice for more customers, more often. That means keeping food, hospitality, convenience and value together. The company also wants each restaurant to operate more effectively, so growth can support a stronger business.

The goal is shared across the system, but the actions can differ by market. One team may test a clearer value offer; another may simplify a popular menu or improve handoffs between digital orders and crew. Local teams know which changes fit their customers and their restaurants.

For a regional update, connect the customer signal to the company goal, then name the decisions local teams can make. Local teams can choose actions that fit their own customers and crew. The message is not simply “move faster.” It is to make the visit easy, worthwhile and welcoming enough that customers choose to return.
verifiedFacts: CEO message sent to the McDonald’s System on June 1, 2026.
The company describes changing competition and customer expectations, including automation and demand for predictable value.
The NEXT ambition is to be customers’ first choice; local markets shape their own path around market, customers and crew.
The stated growth aims include bringing customers more often and improving unit economics.

notes.phrase: customers want prices they can plan around
notes.meaning: 顾客希望价格稳定、可预期
notes.explain: plan around 表示安排计划时把某因素考虑进去；用于说明顾客对价格的期待。
notes.example: Customers want prices they can plan around during the busy season.

notes.phrase: become the first choice for more customers
notes.explain: first choice 用来说明顾客在多个选项中的优先选择。
notes.example: Our goal is to become the first choice for local families.

notes.phrase: fit their own customers and crew
notes.meaning: 适合各自的顾客和员工
notes.explain: fit 在这里表示做法与对象的需要相匹配。
notes.example: The service plan should fit local customers and crew.

scenario.title: 练习情境（虚构）：推出新的门店服务
english: A casual dining chain is seeing more app orders and fewer conversations between customers and staff.
Customers still expect reliable prices and a friendly visit. Local managers can adjust pickup signs, staffing and service recovery.
Write a three-sentence update that connects the customer change, business goal and local actions.
chinese: 一家休闲餐饮连锁发现，App 订单增加，顾客与员工的交谈减少。
顾客仍然期待价格稳定、到店体验友好。当地经理可以调整取餐标识、人员安排和服务补救方式。
请写三句话，把顾客变化、业务目标和当地行动连起来。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给区域运营团队写三句话：根据麦当劳 2026 年 6 月 1 日 NEXT 战略信息，说明顾客同时看重什么、公司希望达成什么经营结果，以及各市场可以怎样选择适合自己的行动。
firstAttempt.sample: As ordering gets more digital, visits may move faster, but guests have fewer chances to speak with crew; they still expect a welcoming visit and predictable value. McDonald’s said its goal was to become the first choice for more customers, more often, while running restaurants more effectively. Each market can test the menu, value offer or order handoff that best fits local guests and crews.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先归纳速度、价格和待客体验，再引用共同目标，最后说明各地可根据顾客与门店情况选择做法。

words.example: Small gestures can improve the hospitality experience.
words.translation: 小小的举动也能改善待客体验。

words.example: Customers value predictable prices and service.
words.translation: 顾客看重稳定的价格和服务。

words.meaning: 单个门店或业务单位的经济效益
words.example: The team is reviewing ways to improve store economics.
words.translation: 团队正在研究提升门店经营效益的方法。

taskPhrases.collocation: expect quick service, reliable value and a welcoming visit

taskPhrases.translation: 顾客期待快速服务、可靠的价格和友好的到店体验。
taskPhrases.explain: expect 后并列列出顾客同时看重的几项体验。

taskPhrases.prompt: 我们的目标是让顾客更常回来。
taskPhrases.example: Our goal is to bring guests back more often.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们的目标是让顾客更常回来。
taskPhrases.explain: bring customers back 表达回访；more often 补充频率。

taskPhrases.collocation: actions that fit its own customers

structure.original: Local teams can choose actions that fit their own customers and crew.
analysis: that fit their own customers and crew 修饰 actions，说明行动要符合当地需求。
用 can choose 表示在共同目标下仍有选择空间。
structure.transfer: Each region can choose a launch plan that fits its customers.
